text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The first race of the "Representative 
Exchange Match," a cornerstone of the 
project, had finally arrived. Public 
anticipation was growing by the day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And on the day of the event—under the 
watchful eyes of many—the members of 
Project L'Arc stepped into the VR Umalator 
one after another.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume from Japan and overseas stand in 
the paddock. Can these contenders stand 
shoulder-to-shoulder with the world...? 
The 1st National Representation Match 
begins.
